title: Records the move wrote, with their built mv: ids, in period starts, period-end answers and settles (decisions X1, Y28; the merge and the model accept mv: ids)
story: The copy of period_end_fixed after a move from 38.31: the bank is mv:acct:cfg, the salary stream mv:pay:steps.a, the trip mv:place:trip and the receipt mv:rc:r1, so the period-end answer is pe:mv:pay:steps.a@2026-11-10:free and the ticked pay set:mv:pay:steps.a@2026-12-10. Set up Fri 20 Nov 2026: the bank holds 400,000, of which 30,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed); a trip place starts empty. Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier) starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month. The pay was ticked as landing Tue 8 Dec, so the period begun by mv:pay:steps.a@2026-11-10 ended Mon 7 Dec. That morning the person answers its period end: 20,000 of Free to spend to the trip, one record pe:mv:pay:steps.a@2026-11-10:free dated the period's last day. On Tue 8 Dec they spend 2,000 from Free to spend. Later they correct the ticked pay's date to Wed 9 Dec (it was in the bank a day later). The period already has answers, so its end stays Mon 7 Dec and the new period still began Tue 8 Dec. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the answer for the period begun by mv:pay:steps.a@2026-11-10, dated its last day
ticked on 8 Dec as landing that day; its date later corrected to 9 Dec

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend for the period that began Tue 8 Dec, the day after the answered period's last day) - 2,000 (spent Tue 8 Dec) = 58,000
asks.note: Before T1 the corrected date moved the period start to Wed 9 Dec and the 2,000 fell in the old period: 60,000.

asks.question: place
asks.why: 0 (opening) + 20,000 (the answer pe:mv:pay:steps.a@2026-11-10:free, its move to the trip) = 20,000
